blocks.text: Stoichiometry chemistry ki woh shakh hai jo balanced kimiyai muadle mein reactants aur products ka miqdari taalluq deti hai. Mole, Avogadro's number, molar mass, molar volume aur molar concentration ke saath balanced muadlon se reactants aur products ke miqdari taalluqat qaim kiye ja sakte hain. Chhe qism ke taalluqat parhe ja sakte hain: mole-mole, mass-mass, volume-volume, mole-mass, mole-volume aur mass-volume. Inhen istemal karne ke liye balanced muadle mein chhupi maloomat parhni hoti hai. N2(g) + 3H2(g) se 2NH3(g) ke liye: N2 ka ek mole H2 ke teen moles se react kar ke NH3 ke do moles banata hai; N2 ka ek molecule H2 ke teen molecules se react kar ke NH3 ke do molecules banata hai; N2 ka 22.4 dm3 H2 ke 67.2 dm3 se react kar ke NH3 ka 44.8 dm3 banata hai; aur N2 ka 28.0 g H2 ke 6 g se react kar ke NH3 ka 34.0 g banata hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Stoichiometric hisabat farz karte hain ke sab reactants poori tarah products mein badal jate hain, mass ki baqa aur muqarrar tanasub ke qanoon qaim rehte hain, aur koi side reaction nahi hoti.

blocks.alt: Paanch gol konon wale dabbe oopar se neeche, teeron se jure: peela (maloom thos ka mass, maloom gas ka hajm ya maloom solution ki molar concentration), hara (mutalliqa formula se maloom ke moles), surkh (balanced muadle se maloom aur na-maloom ka tanasub), neela (na-maloom ke moles) aur narangi (na-maloom ke moles ko mass, hajm ya concentration mein badalna).
blocks.caption: Stoichiometric hisabat ka tareeqa (kitab ke safha 82 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Maloom thos ke mass, maloom gas ke hajm, ya maloom solution ki molar concentration se shuru karein.
Mutalliqa formula se maloom ke moles ki tadaad nikalein.
Balanced muadle se maloom aur na-maloom reactant ya product ka tanasub nikalein.
Us tanasub se na-maloom ke moles ki tadaad nikalein.
Na-maloom ke moles ko mass, hajm ya concentration mein badlein.

blocks.text: Sample 4.12 mein 32.0 / 159.6 ko 0.02 mol aur jawab 1.08 g chhapa hai; taqseem 0.2 mol deti hai, to 0.4 mol Al, 10.8 g. Sample 4.11 ki aakhri satar mein '3.6 moles of N2' hai jahan 3.3 murad hai.

blocks.prompt: 2.25 mol glucose istemal hone par kitne mol CO2 bante hain (C6H12O6 + 6O2 = 6CO2 + 6H2O)? 160 g Fe2O3 se kitna Fe milta hai (Fe2O3 + 3CO = 2Fe + 3CO2)? 4.5 dm3 CH4 jalane se STP par CO2 ka kya hajm milta hai (CH4 + 2O2 = CO2 + 2H2O)? 2.25 mol Cl2 se NaOCl ka kya mass milta hai (2NaOH + Cl2 = NaOCl + NaCl + H2O)?
blocks.explanation: Glucose: 6 x 2.25 = 13.5 mol CO2. Hematite: 160 / 159.6 = 1.0 mol Fe2O3 se 2.0 mol Fe = 2.0 x 55.8 = 111.6 g (112 g). Methane: gas ke hajm mole tanasub 1 : 1 par chalte hain, to 4.5 dm3 CO2. Bleach: 1 mol Cl2 se 1 mol NaOCl, to 2.25 mol x 74.5 g/mol = 167.6 g.

items: Balanced muadla mole, molecule, hajm (STP par) aur mass ke tanasub deta hai: N2 + 3H2 = 2NH3 1 : 3 : 2 mol, 22.4 : 67.2 : 44.8 dm3, 28.0 : 6 : 34.0 g hai.
Tareeqa: maloom miqdar se moles, muadle se mole tanasub, na-maloom ke moles, phir mass, hajm ya concentration; mukammal tabdeeli, dono qanoon aur koi side reaction na hona farz.
